extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners, patent attorneys/agents, and patent applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and procedural criteria governing examination of U.S. patent applications (MPEP Chapter 700). Covers what examiners and applicants must do during search, office actions, rejections, replies, interviews, affidavits/declarations, abandonment, and handling of confidential materials.
